channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: 'Criticism welcome, but bring facts': Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman hits back at Rahul Gandhi, says Budget prioritises MSMEs & rural India
item.description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman on Sunday rebutted Rahul Gandhi's criticism of the Union Budget, saying it focuses on MSMEs, farmers, women entrepreneurs, and rural workers amid global uncertainty. She said political criticism is welcome but must be backed by facts. Gandhi had termed the Budget blind to issues like unemployment, farmers' distress, and falling manufacturing.

item.title: Gold, silver continue to decline as CME margin requirements hike set to take effect
item.description: Analysts said the free fall of gold and silver from their record highs started after the US President Donald Trump selected Kevin Warsh as the next US Fed Chairman. Investors reacted negatively because Warsh is considered more aggressive on interest-rate policy than earlier chairs, they added.

item.title: US experts back India's growth, urge manufacturing push
item.description: US-based economists and business leaders have welcomed India's Union Budget, saying it reinforces the country's strong growth momentum and sends positive signals to global trade and investors.

item.title: CJ Roy suicide case: CM Vijayan writes to FM Nirmala Sitharaman seeking judicial probe
item.description: Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan has written to Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman seeking a judicial probe into the death of real estate developer and Confident Group Chairman C.J. Roy, who allegedly died by suicide during an Income Tax search operation on January 30.

item.title: Budget's focus on AI-enabled skilling to nurture India's future entrepreneurs: Industry
item.description: Industry leaders have welcomed the Union Budget 2026 for its strong focus on AI-enabled skilling and technology-driven education to nurture India's future entrepreneurs. The Budget marks a shift from technology adoption to building strategic capabilities through initiatives such as the India AI Mission, National Quantum Mission and expanded research funding.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty in green despite negative global cues
item.description: As of 9.33 am, Sensex added 373 points, or 0.46 per cent, to reach 81,096, and Nifty gained 87 points, or 0.35 per cent to settle at 24,913.

item.title: Spiritual leader Dalai Lama secures Grammy win at 90 for his spoken-word album
item.description: Dalai Lama won his first Grammy for 'Meditations', a collaborative project with sarod maestro Amjad Ali Khan and his sons Amaan Ali Bangash, Ayaan Ali Bangash, along with Kabir Sehgal.

item.title: Vijay Devarakonda and Rashmika Mandanna to tie knot on February 26
item.description: Vijay Devarakonda and Rashmika Mandanna are gearing up to tie the knot at a grand wedding ceremony to be held at the Udaipur palace in Rajasthan on February 26.

item.title: 'It's not our decision': Salman Agha reacts after Pakistan government decides on India T20 World Cup clash
item.description: Pakistan have decided not to pull out of the upcoming T20 World Cup set to be played in India and Sri Lanka. However, PCB have decided to boycott the match against arch-rival India which was scheduled to take place on February 15 in Colombo. The development was confirmed by Government of Pakistan.

item.title: "Hearing that Chiranjeevi spoke about me brought tears to my eyes": Naveen Polishetty
item.description: Naveen Polishetty says that releasing a film alongside Chiranjeevi's movie and succeeding is a dream moment for him. Hearing that he spoke about him brought tears to his eyes.
